const tokens = (value) => Math.ceil(Buffer.byteLength((0,__vite_ssr_import_6__.canonicalizeCompleteJson)(value, {
	maxBytes: 1e6,
	maxDepth: 64,

const id = "synthetic.complete.echo";
function lane(output, options = {}) {
	const requests = [];
	const toolBodies = [];
	let bodies = 0;
	let sensitiveBodies = 0;
	let outputValidations = 0;
	const operationKeys = [];
	let capabilities = (0,__vite_ssr_import_8__.createCapabilityRegistry)([{
		descriptor: {
			id,
			version: "1",
			description: "Pure synthetic complete result",
			inputSchema: { type: "object" },
			outputSchema: {},
			risk: "LOW",
			sideEffect: options.sideEffect ?? "NONE",
			idempotent: true,
			requiresApproval: false,
			origin: "core",
			providerId: "synthetic.complete",
			providerVersion: "1"
		},
		implementation: {
			validateInput: () => true,
			validateOutput: () => {
				outputValidations++;
				return true;
			},
			execute: async (input, context) => {
				bodies++;
				operationKeys.push(context.operationKey);
				const deliveredOutput = options.echoText === undefined ? bodies === 2 && options.nextOutput !== undefined ? options.nextOutput : output : input.text;
				toolBodies.push({
					name: id,
					input: structuredClone(input),
					output: deliveredOutput
				});
				return {
					status: "SUCCEEDED",
					output: deliveredOutput
				};
			}
		}
	}]);
	const sensitiveId = `${id}.sensitive`;
	if (options.sensitiveAttempt) capabilities = capabilities.register({
		descriptor: {
			id: sensitiveId,
			version: "1",
			description: "Synthetic approval control, no external effect",
			inputSchema: {},
			outputSchema: {},
			risk: "MEDIUM",
			sideEffect: "WRITE",
			idempotent: false,
			requiresApproval: true,
			origin: "core",
			providerId: "synthetic.complete",
			providerVersion: "1"
		},
		implementation: {
			validateInput: () => true,
			validateOutput: () => true,
			execute: async () => {
				sensitiveBodies++;
				return {
					status: "SUCCEEDED",
					output: "synthetic only"
				};
			}
		}
	});
	const model = { complete: async ({ signal: _signal, ...request }) => {
		void _signal;
		requests.push(structuredClone(request));
		if (options.modelFault === "throw") throw new Error("synthetic model loss");
		(0,__vite_ssr_import_5__.expect)(request.maxOutputTokens).toBe(512);
		const frame = JSON.parse(request.messages[1].content);
		const observed = frame.items.find((item) => item.value?.type === "TOOL_RESULT");
		// The answer is derived only from the actual delivered request, never output above.
		const decision = observed ? options.sensitiveAttempt ? {
			decisionType: "CALL_TOOL",
			reasonCode: "TOOL_REQUIRED",
			toolId: sensitiveId,
			toolVersion: "1",
			toolInput: {}
		} : options.secondTool && requests.length === 2 ? {
			decisionType: "CALL_TOOL",
			reasonCode: "TOOL_REQUIRED",
			toolId: id,
			toolVersion: "1",
			toolInput: { round: 2 }
		} : {
			decisionType: "RESPOND",
			reasonCode: "GOAL_SATISFIED",
			responseText: options.responseMode === "digest" ? `sha256:${(0,__vite_ssr_import_0__.createHash)("sha256").update((0,__vite_ssr_import_6__.canonicalizeCompleteJson)(observed.value.payload.output)).digest("hex")}` : typeof observed.value.payload.output === "string" ? observed.value.payload.output : (0,__vite_ssr_import_6__.canonicalizeCompleteJson)(observed.value.payload.output)
		} : {
			decisionType: "CALL_TOOL",
			reasonCode: "TOOL_REQUIRED",
			toolId: id,
			toolVersion: "1",
			toolInput: options.echoText === undefined ? {} : { text: options.echoText }
		};
		const text = JSON.stringify(decision);
		(0,__vite_ssr_import_5__.expect)(tokens(text)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(512);
		return {
			text,
			provider: "synthetic.complete",
			model: "toy64-v1",
			inputTokens: tokens(request),
			outputTokens: options.modelFault === "usage" ? 513 : tokens(text),
			costUsd: 0
		};
	} };
	const counter = { measure: async (request) => ({
		counterId: "toy64",
		counterVersion: "1",
		provider: "synthetic.complete",
		model: "toy64-v1",
		formattingVersion: "1",
		inputUpperBoundTokens: tokens(request),
		contextWindowTokens: 1e5,
		costUpperBoundUsd: 0
	}) };
	const steps = new __vite_ssr_import_8__.InMemoryExecutionStepStore();
	const cas = steps.compareAndSwapCheckpoint.bind(steps);
	steps.compareAndSwapCheckpoint = async (input) => {
		options.checkpointGuard?.(input.next);
		return cas(input);
	};
	const audit = new __vite_ssr_import_9__.RecordingAuditSink();
	const approvals = new __vite_ssr_import_9__.InMemoryApprovalEngine();
	const journal = new __vite_ssr_import_8__.InMemoryEffectJournal();
	const harness = (0,__vite_ssr_import_8__.createOperationalHarness)({
		toolResultContext: { version: 1 },
		capabilities,
		effectJournal: journal,
		stepStore: steps,
		...options.contextEngine ? { contextEngine: options.contextEngine } : {},
		iterativeOrchestrator: new __vite_ssr_import_7__.HybridOrchestrator({
			decisionModel: model,
			...options.rules ? { rules: options.rules } : {},
			...options.counter === false ? {} : { decisionInputCounter: counter },
			decisionModelSupportsMaxOutputTokens: true
		}),
		modelGateway: model,
		policy: new __vite_ssr_import_9__.ScriptedPolicyEngine(),
		approvals,
		audit,
		telemetry: new __vite_ssr_import_9__.RecordingTelemetrySink()
	});
	const base = (0,__vite_ssr_import_9__.phase3RuntimeInput)();
	const input = {
		...base,
		capabilityFingerprint: capabilities.compositionFingerprint(),
		agent: (0,__vite_ssr_import_9__.phase3AgentProfile)({ tools: options.sensitiveAttempt ? [id, sensitiveId] : [id] }),
		userMessage: "Read the synthetic tool and return its full output.",
		budget: {
			...base.budget,
			maxTokens: options.maxTokens ?? 1e4
		}
	};
	return {
		harness,
		input,
		requests,
		steps,
		audit,
		toolBodies,
		approvals,
		journal,
		operationKeys,
		outputValidations: () => outputValidations,
		sensitiveBodies: () => sensitiveBodies,
		bodies: () => bodies
	};
}
function assertPublicJsonEvidence(evidence, json) {
	const { result, requests, checkpoint, journal, operationKey } = evidence;
	(0,__vite_ssr_import_5__.expect)(result.stopReason).toBe("COMPLETED");
	const digest = (0,__vite_ssr_import_0__.createHash)("sha256").update(json, "utf8").digest("hex");
	(0,__vite_ssr_import_5__.expect)(result.response).toBe("sha256:" + digest);
	(0,__vite_ssr_import_5__.expect)(evidence.bodies).toBe(1);
	(0,__vite_ssr_import_5__.expect)(evidence.outputValidations).toBe(1);
	(0,__vite_ssr_import_5__.expect)(requests).toHaveLength(2);
	(0,__vite_ssr_import_5__.expect)(checkpoint?.checkpointVersion).toBe(2);
	const observation = checkpoint.state.observations.find((o) => o.type === "TOOL_RESULT");
	const request = requests[1];
	const frame = JSON.parse(request.messages[1].content);
	const received = frame.items.find((item) => item.value?.type === "TOOL_RESULT").value;
	(0,__vite_ssr_import_5__.expect)(received).toEqual(observation);
	(0,__vite_ssr_import_5__.expect)(received.payload).toMatchObject({
		output: JSON.parse(json),
		completion: "COMPLETE",
		resultAvailability: "AVAILABLE",
		outputBytes: Buffer.byteLength(json, "utf8"),
		outputSha256: digest
	});
	(0,__vite_ssr_import_5__.expect)(received.trust).toBe("UNTRUSTED");
	(0,__vite_ssr_import_5__.expect)(received.provenance.operationKey).toBe(operationKey);
	(0,__vite_ssr_import_5__.expect)(journal).toMatchObject({
		tenantId: checkpoint.tenantId,
		operationKey,
		state: "CONFIRMED",
		result: JSON.parse(json)
	});
	const receipts = checkpoint.state.toolResultContext.decisionAdmissions;
	(0,__vite_ssr_import_5__.expect)(receipts.map((r) => r.status)).toEqual(["SETTLED", "SETTLED"]);
	for (const receipt of receipts) {
		(0,__vite_ssr_import_5__.expect)(receipt.tenantId).toBe(checkpoint.tenantId);
		(0,__vite_ssr_import_5__.expect)(receipt.executionId).toBe(checkpoint.executionId);
	};
	(0,__vite_ssr_import_5__.expect)(checkpoint.budgetUsage.toolCalls).toBe(1);
	(0,__vite_ssr_import_5__.expect)(checkpoint.budgetUsage.modelCalls).toBe(2);
	for (const field of [
		"inputTokens",
		"outputTokens",
		"costUsd"
	]) (0,__vite_ssr_import_5__.expect)(checkpoint.budgetUsage[field]).toBe(receipts.reduce((sum, receipt) => sum + receipt.actual[field], 0));
}

	__vite_ssr_import_5__.it.each([
		"summary",
		"output",
		"hash",
		"id",
		"cursor",
		"required-set",
		"payload"
	])("refuses custom context tampering (%s) before the next model", async (mutation) => {
		const engine = new __vite_ssr_import_8__.DefaultContextEngine();
		const l = lane("intact", { contextEngine: { build: async (input) => {
			const context = await engine.build(input);
			const observation = context.observations.find((o) => o.type === "TOOL_RESULT");
			if (observation && (mutation === "cursor" || mutation === "required-set")) return {
				...context,
				toolResultContext: {
					...context.toolResultContext,
					...mutation === "cursor" ? { deliveredThroughStep: 999 } : { requiredObservationIds: [] }
				}
			};
			const payload = observation?.payload;
			const changed = observation ? mutation === "summary" ? {
				...observation,
				summary: "forged"
			} : mutation === "id" ? {
				...observation,
				observationId: "forged"
			} : {
				...observation,
				payload: mutation === "output" ? {
					...payload,
					output: "forged"
				} : mutation === "hash" ? {
					...payload,
					outputSha256: "0".repeat(64)
				} : {
					status: "SUCCEEDED",
					output: "forged"
				}
			} : undefined;
			return observation ? {
				...context,
				observations: context.observations.map((o) => o === observation ? changed : o)
			} : context;
		} } });
		const result = await l.harness.run(l.input);
		traces.push({
			name: `tampered-context-${mutation}`,
			result,
			requests: l.requests
		});
		(0,__vite_ssr_import_5__.expect)(result.stopReason).toBe("STATE_CONFLICT");
		(0,__vite_ssr_import_5__.expect)(l.requests).toHaveLength(1);
		(0,__vite_ssr_import_5__.expect)(l.bodies()).toBe(1);
	});
